_source: Gerodur GEROtherm DUPLEX geothermal probe product page (dimension table), retrieved 2026-09-21 from gerodur.de/en/gerotherm-duplex/. Material confirmed as PE100-RC (RC = resistance to crack) on the same page.
_material_conductivity_note: Gerodur's product page does not publish a pipe-material thermal conductivity value. Following the same reasoning REHAU's own Technical Bulletin TB246 documents for PE-Xa (negligible difference vs. generic PE for geothermal modeling purposes), k_p uses the same industry-standard 0.40 W/m.K value used elsewhere in this engine for PE-family pipe materials -- not an unsourced Gerodur-specific figure.
